high_level_description: This image is a promotional post for the movie "Theekkoluthi," which is presented by Applause Entertainment and PA Ranjith. The poster features a black-and-white photograph of two individuals embracing each other closely. The woman is leaning into the man's chest, with her head resting on his shoulder, suggesting an intimate or emotional moment. The man has his arms wrapped around the woman, holding her close. The background is textured and dark, with flames on the left side, adding a dramatic and intense atmosphere to the scene.
